name: digiquiz-web-tier
description: DigiQuiz public web tier — validates and forwards /api/* to the private app tier, server-renders /admin. NO DATABASE CLIENT. Used by the Path A Docker image.

comments.one-dependency: express is the only runtime dependency. Requests are forwarded with the global fetch() built into Node 18+, so there is no HTTP-client dependency either.
deliberately-absent: mysql2 / any driver — this tier must never open a database connection, and web-tier/Dockerfile fails the build if one appears
jsonwebtoken — this tier holds no signing key and cannot verify tokens; it decodes the /admin token for a redirect decision only, and the app tier re-checks the signature
bcryptjs — password hashing happens in the app tier only
comments.node18: Node 18+ is required for the built-in fetch() used by the forwarder.
